label: Bathroom remodel
dataBasis: PLACEHOLDER REFERENCE DATA (Aug 2026). All unit costs and labor hours are modelled reference values pending a licensed cost-data source and sanity-check by two working contractors. Do not treat as market pricing.

citations.label: Placeholder pricing basis — internal reference model, pending licensed cost data and contractor review

laborRateBasis: labor: regional median remodel-trades blended rate, Aug 2026 placeholder ($68/hr base before regional multiplier)

assemblies.label: Demolition & disposal
assemblies.materialBasis: materials: dumpster + disposal fees per sq ft, Aug 2026 placeholder; labor: regional median placeholder
assumptions: Down to studs on wet walls only

assemblies.label: Plumbing rough-in & finish
assemblies.materialBasis: materials: supply/waste lines, valves, finish plumbing per bath, Aug 2026 placeholder; labor: regional median placeholder
assumptions: Fixtures stay in current locations; moving drains is a change order

assemblies.label: Electrical: GFCI, fan, lighting
assemblies.materialBasis: materials: GFCI circuits, exhaust fan, fixtures per bath, Aug 2026 placeholder; labor: regional median placeholder
assumptions: Panel has capacity for a new circuit

assemblies.label: Floor tile & underlayment
assemblies.materialBasis: materials: economy = ceramic, mid = porcelain, premium = natural stone, incl. backer + setting materials, Aug 2026 placeholder; labor: regional median placeholder
assumptions: Subfloor is sound; leveling or joist repair is a change order

assemblies.label: Shower/tub wall tile
assemblies.materialBasis: materials: wall tile incl. waterproofing membrane + setting materials, Aug 2026 placeholder; labor: regional median placeholder

assemblies.label: Tub / shower unit
assemblies.materialBasis: materials: economy = acrylic tub, mid = quality tub or shower base + door, premium = custom base + frameless glass, Aug 2026 placeholder; labor: regional median placeholder

assemblies.label: Vanity, toilet & finish fixtures
assemblies.materialBasis: materials: vanity + top, toilet, faucet, mirror, accessories, Aug 2026 placeholder; labor: regional median placeholder
assumptions: Stock vanity sizes; custom cabinetry priced separately

assemblies.label: Drywall repair & paint
assemblies.materialBasis: materials: moisture-resistant board, mud, bath paint per sq ft of wall (2.5x floor area rule of thumb), Aug 2026 placeholder; labor: regional median placeholder
assumptions: Wall area estimated at 2.5x floor area
